_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for business facts. Edit here, run `python3 build.py`, redeploy. Each fact has a status: 'verified' = stated on jchautoworksllc.org (audited 2026-10-28) or visible in owner-supplied photos; 'confirm' = needs owner sign-off before launch (hidden from the public site while show=false).

business.name: JCH Auto Works LLC
business.legalNameOnOldSite: J C H Auto Works LLC

experience.text: Over 30 years of auto body expertise
experience.status: verified wording; CONFIRM whose experience (owner vs. team) — the business itself is described as recently established

icar.status: verified (old site says 'iCar-Certified technician'); CONFIRM certificate level (e.g. Platinum / ProLevel) and name before stating more

insurance.text: Works with all major insurance companies
insurance.status: verified wording; NOT a direct-repair-program (DRP) claim

warranty.text: Lifetime workmanship warranty for as long as you own the vehicle; parts carry the manufacturer's warranty
warranty.status: verified; CONFIRM written warranty terms/exclusions document

repairUpdates.text: Repair updates while your vehicle is at the shop

nysRegistered.text: Registered New York State motor vehicle repair shop
nysRegistered.status: sign visible in the REAL storefront photo; CONFIRM DMV facility number to display

established.status: CONFIRM year the LLC opened (old site: 'recently established'; copyright 2023)

towing.status: CONFIRM — does JCH tow, or arrange towing?

inspection.status: CONFIRM — second sign in photo may be an NYS inspection station sign

services.name: Structural Repair
services.source: verified (FAQ: structural repair); CONFIRM frame/measuring equipment before naming it

services.name: Windshield & Glass
services.source: verified (FAQ); CONFIRM in-house vs. partner installer

services.name: Diagnostics & Calibration
services.source: verified (FAQ: diagnostics & calibration); CONFIRM which ADAS calibrations are in-house vs. sublet

serviceArea.status: CONFIRM — list shown as 'customers often come from'; no city doorway pages are generated

reviews.status: No reviews published. Add only real, permission-granted reviews: {"name":"First L.","text":"...","source":"Google","date":"2026-11"}. No star rating is shown or put in schema until real data exists.

gallery.status: Add authorized before/after pairs: {"before":"img/x-before.webp","after":"img/x-after.webp","vehicle":"2021 Jeep Grand Cherokee","repair":"Front bumper & headlamp","note":"..."}

integrations._formsMode: auto = live Netlify Forms on the production/Netlify domain, labeled demo mode anywhere else (claude.ai preview, localhost). Force with 'live' or 'demo'.

media._note: The storefront photo (jch-auto-works-shop-exterior-*) is a REAL photo of the shop. The two interior images (illustrative-*) are generated illustrations and are always labeled 'Illustrative image'. Replace them with real shop photos, then set illustrative=false.
